---
title: "Ablation Study: Orben 2019 (NHB) - YRBS"
format: pdf
---

```{r setup}
here::i_am("orben2019-ablation-1-YRBS.qmd")
source(here::here("R", "_load.R"))
```

This document contains the ablation study for the YRBS multiverse dataset from
Orben & Przybylski (2019, *Nature Human Behaviour*). Every decision is fixed
to one option in turn, importance estimates are recomputed on the reduced
multiverse, and the resulting importance vectors are compared across methods
and across options of the fixed decision.

```{r yrbs-load-data}
mv_yrbs <- load_multiverse("orben2019nhb_yrbs")
```

## Ablation Study

`mv_dim_y_variable` is one-hot encoded (via `expand_y_variable()`) for the
regression and FANOVA methods: regression needs a numeric design matrix, and
FANOVA's random forest cannot handle the raw categorical with its many unique
levels. DECIDE uses it as-is. The expanded per-variable importances are
collapsed back to a single `mv_dim_y_variable` entry.

```{r yrbs-ablation-run}
ablation_yrbs <- run_ablation_analysis(
  mv_yrbs,
  colname_metric = "effect",
  regression_mv_pre_process = expand_y_variable,
  regression_post_process = aggregate_onehot_importances,
  fanova_mv_pre_process = expand_y_variable,
  fanova_post_process = aggregate_onehot_importances,
  cor_method = "pearson",
  exclude_inert = TRUE
)
```

### Inter-method stability

```{r yrbs-ablation-inter-method-table}
ablation_yrbs$inter_method_stability_summary |>
  mutate(
    fixed_decision_label = if_else(
      fixed_decision == "full_multiverse",
      "full multiverse",
      fixed_decision_label
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    fixed_decision_label,
    method_x,
    method_y,
    mean_rank_correlation,
    min_rank_correlation
  )
```

```{r yrbs-ablation-inter-method-plot}
#| fig-width: 3.2
#| fig-height: 2.5
# same row order in the inter- and intra-method heatmaps
decision_order_yrbs <- stability_decision_order(ablation_yrbs$intra_method_stability_summary)
p_inter_yrbs <- vis_inter_method_stability(
  ablation_yrbs$inter_method_stability_summary,
  include_negative = TRUE,
  fill_label = "Mean Pearson\ncorrelation",
  fill_option = "plasma",
  decision_order = decision_order_yrbs,
  value_size = 1.6
) + theme_stability_compact(left_margin = 22)
p_inter_yrbs
```

```{r yrbs-ablation-inter-method-matrix}
#| fig-width: 3.75
#| fig-height: 3.25
# method pairs on the full multiverse (upper) and averaged over all ablated
# multiverses (lower), i.e. the rows of the heatmap above
p <- vis_inter_method_matrix(
  ablation_yrbs$inter_method_stability_summary,
  include_negative = TRUE,
  fill_label = "Mean Pearson\ncorrelation",
  fill_option = "plasma",
  value_size = 1.6
) + theme_stability_compact(wrap_y_labels = FALSE)
p
ggsave(here("figures", "yrbs-ablation-inter-method-matrix.pdf"), p, width = 3.75, height = 3.25, create.dir = TRUE)
```

### Intra-method stability

```{r yrbs-ablation-intra-method-table}
ablation_yrbs$intra_method_stability_summary |>
  select(
    fixed_decision_label,
    method,
    mean_rank_correlation,
    min_rank_correlation,
    mean_abs_difference
  )
```

```{r yrbs-ablation-intra-method-plot}
#| fig-width: 2.5
#| fig-height: 1.9
p_intra_yrbs <- vis_intra_method_stability(
  ablation_yrbs$intra_method_stability_summary,
  include_negative = TRUE,
  fill_label = "Mean Pearson\ncorrelation",
  fill_option = "cividis",
  decision_order = decision_order_yrbs,
  value_size = 1.6
) + theme_stability_compact()
p_intra_yrbs
```

```{r yrbs-ablation-save-heatmaps}
# the intra-method heatmap is sized to match the tiles, text and legend of
# the inter-method matrix, so the two can be placed side by side
ggsave(here("figures", "yrbs-ablation-inter-method.pdf"), p_inter_yrbs, width = 3.2, height = 2.5, create.dir = TRUE)
ggsave(here("figures", "yrbs-ablation-intra-method.pdf"), p_intra_yrbs, width = 2.5, height = 1.9, create.dir = TRUE)
```
